results.title: Transporting over 60 million tons of dry bulk cargoes every year; safely, efficiently and with care to the environment
results.snippet: Sources describe it as a global seaborne transporter of dry bulk, moving iron ore, coal, grain, fertilizers, and minor bulks. Its core business is the ownership and operation of a large, diversified fleet of dry bulk vessels that generate revenue through time charters, spot market voyages, and contracts of affreightment.

results.title: Creating shareholder value through world-class ship operations and sustainable growth
results.snippet: The company's stated aim is to be a high quality and cost efficient ship operator while sustainably expanding its fleet in the dry bulk sector through acquisitions that are accretive for its shareholders.

results.title: We aspire to be the global leader in sustainable dry bulk shipping
results.snippet: The fleet spans Supramax vessels to Newcastlemax vessels, with Capesize and Kamsarmax ships also cited.

results.title: Plunkett Research Online: Star Bulk Carriers Corp
results.snippet: Charterers typically include major commodity producers, traders, and industrial end users. One profile says it has chartered vessels for Rio Tinto, Hyundai Merchant (the list is truncated in the source).

results.title: Star Bulk Carriers - Company Profile
results.snippet: Its revenue comes from a single operating segment that mixes spot voyages with fixed-rate time charters. The company does not depend on one customer.

results.title: Star Bulk Carriers
results.snippet: Ship management runs through subsidiaries, including Star Bulk SA and Star Bulk Cyprus, which the company says lets it capture scale synergies.
